(yyyy)` pattern, skip sanitizer); OR (b) build whitelist for known author names + key academic terms; OR (c) make sanitizer aware of citation blocks (e.g. `> ` blockquote citations bypass). Option (a) is cleanest. Implement in scripts/feed_sanitizer or wherever the sanitizer regex lives + add 5 regression tests covering Harvey/Liu/Zhu/DM/Patton/Bollerslev citation forms.
findings: Citation-context exemption landed. publish_draft.py + publisher.py symmetrically patched (Option A regex stash/restore). 5 citation patterns (3-author/et-al/2-author/single/comma-year), ASCII+fullwidth bracket support, year-suffix variant. 25 new tests + 22/23 existing PASS (1 unrelated pre-existing fail). error_log.md +4 lessons. findings: Codex primary-path review (codex 0.121.0) — 5 points: 3 PASS + 1 MINOR + 1 MAJOR. (1) PASS numbers byte-aligned (QLIKE -8.527/-8.194/-7.453/-2.670/+2.301/+2.302/+2.447, OOS R²s, n_oos=1824, n_factors=10). (2) PASS QLIKE sign correct, avoided results.json `improvement_pct=-4.07` 語義 trap. (3) MINOR § 4 narrative over-packaging — 「呼應先前多次日頻 GARCH ceiling」太滿；K973 同 daily r² target 但 HAR > GJR — 應寫「另一個 daily noisy-proxy 下 GJR 強勢的案例」. (4) PASS VIX² 8/8 rolling 100% selection byte-aligned. (5) MAJOR shift(1) lookahead claim 太滿。10 factors feature-level lag 都做對，rolling refit 邊界也無 OOS lookahead，但 LassoCV(cv=5) / ElasticNetCV(cv=5) / KFold(shuffle=False) Ridge 都用 plain 5-fold CV → 訓練窗內較晚資料參與較早 fold alpha 選擇 = within-window CV leakage. 應改：「feature-level lag 1 期；但 hyperparameter 選擇用 5-fold CV 而非 TimeSeriesSplit」。Verdict: 主結論 (adaptive HAR no improvement, GJR wins, VIX² consistently selected) source-code 站得住，但需 errata v2 修 2 點 (narrative softening + CV-leakage caveat). 3-model review pattern (Claude → Gemini → Codex) 又一次 surface真問題.

title: K982 post-publish Codex review (24h-rule): mile_9ed87beb sector dispersion + correlation regime
description: Run Codex review on mile_9ed87beb (K982 general-audience article). Check: (1) numerical accuracy vs k982_dispersion_results.json, (2) VIX-sufficiency framing balance (positive=null=success vs negative=no improvement), (3) descriptive vs predictive distinction (regime t=13.7 IS real but VIX subsumes it), (4) shift(1) lookahead claim correctness, (5) source-code-level checks Gemini cannot do.
findings: Codex primary-path review 5 points: 1 PASS + 2 MAJOR + 2 MINOR. (1) MAJOR sample size mismatch: 文章 n=1936 / 2018-06-20 start, results.json effective n_observations=1913 / IS_period 2018-07-24 (rolling 22d + rv_future shift(-22) + predictor shift(1) 縮 sample). (2) MAJOR high-corr t=13.7 是 stats.ttest_ind(rv_future_high, rv_future_low) two-sample mean test, 不是 descriptive 也不是 incremental predictive; 而且 22-day overlapping rv_future 有自相關沒做 HAC/block bootstrap 修正 → t-stat 有 overstated 風險, "PASS Harvey 3.0" claim 太強. (3) PASS DM 4 augmented model framing 平衡 (M2/M3/M4 p>0.12). (4) MINOR strategy backtest 是 gross-of-cost, 文章沒明標 (JSON limitations 有寫). (5) MINOR regime classification 用同日 avg_corr (非 lagged) — 這對 forward sort 是 OK 因 same-day observable, 但文章 "全 shift(1)" 覆蓋過寬. Verdict: 主結論 (VIX-sufficiency confirmation) source-code 站得住, 但需 errata v2 修 4 點 (sample size + regime framing + cost caveat + lookahead 細化).

title: [platform_ops] cron_review.py: weekday-restricted cron 用 croniter 算 expected last fire，不用 fixed max_gap_h（false alarm fix）
description:
Issue: scripts/cron_review.py JOBS dict 用 fixed max_gap_h (collect_us=30, daily_update=30) 判 stale，但這些 cron 設計就限制 weekday range (collect_us='3 7 * * 2-6' = Tue-Sat, daily_update='3 8 * * 1-6' = Mon-Sat)。週日 / 週一遇到 collect_us=30h gap 就 false alarm 寄 boss_report '⚠️ >30h' 給用戶。

2026-05-25 22:00 boss_report 即此 false alarm — 用戶 21:04 回信問「要先處理嗎」。實際 collect_us 健康（週日 5/24 + 週一 5/25 本就不在 cron 範圍）。

Fix:
1. JOBS dict 改帶 cron expression（直接讀 config/runtime_schedules.json）
2. 用 croniter.get_prev() 計算 'expected last fire'（依 cron schedule，週日週一自動 skip）
3. staleness = now - max(expected_last_fire, log_last_end)；超過 1.5 * cron interval 才 flag
4. Regression test: 餵 2026-05-25 22:00 + collect_us cron='3 7 * * 2-6' + log_last=2026-05-23 08:00 → 應判 healthy（next expected = 2026-05-26 07:03 Tue）

Mission alignment: 平台運營 (#4) — monitor 不該 cry wolf，每天 noise email 會降低用戶警覺敏感度（→ 真 incident 也被忽略）。

Provenance: hourly-22 dispatch 2026-05-25 22:09 diagnose K-? incident，email-11761-7800a4 已 close。
result: Made cron_review.py schedule-aware by reading config/runtime_schedules.json and computing previous expected fire via croniter instead of fixed max_gap_h for weekday-only jobs. Added 3 regression tests covering the 2026-05-25 collect_us weekend false-alarm case; tests passed.

title: K1320 fix: remove dynamic copula np.interp lookahead + redo DM test with valid loss
description:
Codex 24h review of mile_2c4efefa (paper_review_mile_2c4efefa, 2026-06-04) flagged 3 must-fix issues in experiments/k1320/k1320.py:
  1. Dynamic Gumbel (k1320.py:541, 580) uses np.interp on future re-estimates → lookahead MED. Change to piecewise-hold (use latest-known estimate until next re-estimate) or expanding-window forecast.
  2. DM test (k1320.py:897, 915, 945) builds e=rets**2 then internal d=e1**2-e2**2 → effective loss = r^4 (UNSOUND). Redo with d_t = r2_DCC,t − r2_model,t HAC DM, OR bootstrap CI on HE difference.
  3. Rename DCC_t (k1320.py:714, 720) → StudentT_Copula_static OR implement true dynamic t-DCC.
Also fix first-day hedge comment/code mismatch (k1320.py:732 vs 749).
After re-run: update article mile_2c4efefa table + statistical-significance language, then re-publish with corrected caveat. Review file: storage/reviews/codex_24h/mile_2c4efefa_review.md.
result: Codex 24h review 找到的 4 個 bugs 全修：(1) np.interp 改 piecewise-hold (HE 0.8876→0.8874 微小) (2) DM loss r^4→squared hedged return (sound) — 新發現 OLS p<0.0001/Rolling OLS p=0.015/Clayton p=0.0001 皆顯著差於 DCC，但 Copula 內部 vs DCC 仍 null (p=0.396) (3) DCC_t → StudentT_Copula_static rename (4) hr_lagged[0]=0 首日 unhedged 對齊註解。Article mile_2c4efefa caveat + 數字 + DM 結論 + OLS 段落改寫 (4108→4739 chars)。圖已重生並上傳 supabase。Commits: 2db4150e (code fix), 957cb2f8 (article patch).
